messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: v2 -> /api/v2/generate (10% traffic, region: us-west). rollout_id=rl-20260320-01 :rocket:
maya: seeing spike in 400s from mobile sdk 1.4.2 since ~1769500300, sample logs attached.
maya: ```
[2026-03-20T22:05:12Z] tenant=tenant-42 method=POST path=/api/v2/generate status=400 body_error="invalid_schema: choices must be array"
```
sam: curious — v2 tightened the response schema for choices (expected array not string). did we miss a fallback?
jonas: looks like a subset of clients still sending legacy prompt form. we expected graceful coerce but we changed strict validation in v2.
anika: can we pin traffic for affected tenants rather than full rollback? tenant-42 is heavy.
ops-bot: suggest action: PIN tenant-42 -> v1, increase canary to 25% paused, notify mobile SDK team. mention @mobile-eng.
maya: +1 to pin. quick command: `deployctl pin --tenant tenant-42 --route /api/v2/generate --version v1` — need ops approval.
jonas: if pin fails we do a targeted rollback for that route. rollback command: `deployctl rollback --route /api/v2/generate --to v1 --reason "strict-schema-regression"`
sam: ops, can we get the pin enacted now? owners on-call? @karen
karen: oncall here, applying pin now. will also flip canary to hold.
karen: `deployctl pin` completed for tenant-42 — confirming 100% of that tenant to v1.
deploy-bot: rollout paused (canary=10% -> hold). awaiting telemetry for next 5m.
maya: after pin, 400 rate for tenant-42 dropped to baseline in logs. still seeing a few 422s from EU region, possibly different sdk versions.
jonas: let's avoid global rollback. plan: 1) pin affected tenants (done), 2) post a small compatibility patch to coerce legacy payloads within v2 (non-breaking), 3) update release notes and mobile SDK guidance, 4) resume slow canary once we have the patch.
anika: I'll draft a short release-note blurb and a developer advisory. link to internal doc: https://redwood.internal/release/rl-20260320-01 (will update).
sam: timeline — can we aim for patch + re-run canary in 90m?
ops-bot: change window advisory: original change window 23:00-00:00. suggest extend to 23:00-01:30 for safe rollback/patch. need approval from product.
anika: pinging @product for window extension.
karen: ops update: monitoring alerting thresholds temporarily lowered for v2 errors to catch regressions. oncall ready for quick rollback.
maya: mobile-eng reached out — SDK 1.4.2 will ship client-side fix tomorrow. they requested more time on server side to avoid user breakage.
jonas: OK. I'll push quick compatibility shim to v2 that accepts single-string choice and converts to [choice]. small patch, no model changes. deploy as canary-only first.
deploy-bot: queued job: patch/compat-shim -> staging. CI green. running canary deploy to 5% (internal) now.
ops-bot: if canary shows <0.1% error delta after 5m, we proceed to 25% and then resume original schedule.
anika: release notes updated: https://redwood.internal/release/rl-20260320-01/notes — added compatibility note and known-client-impact section. please add any words.
sam: thanks team. once we confirm telemetry stable for 20m at 25%, move to 50%. ops: keep rollback command ready in #runbooks.
karen: confirmed. rollback command aliased in runbook: `rb-rollout-v2-generate` (executes route-level rollback).
deploy-bot: canary to 5% passed 10m checks. increasing to 25%.
maya: 25% looks clean for US, EU still small blip but within SLA.
jonas: leaving the shim in place for one week, schedule a follow-up to remove after SDK adoption. will file RFC.
anika: updated release notes with rollback criteria and callouts. sent a short notif to customers who opted-in to early-access.
ops-bot: change window extension approved by product (noted).
sam: final ask — add a short migration snippet to docs with example transformation for legacy payloads. jonas, can you add?
jonas: on it. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/release-docs/pull/482
deploy-bot: closing the thread: rollout held + tenant pins applied + compat patch deployed as canary. reopen if anything spikes. :white_check_mark:
